caption: A player hits the ball off the side of the mallet, resulting in an unexpected trajectory.
positive_analysis:
1. Mallet strikes ball with force, altering its velocity and direction due to material deformation and friction at contact.  
2. Ball’s mass and elasticity determine how it rebounds off mallet’s side, preserving momentum and energy.  
3. Surface texture of mallet and ball affects friction, influencing spin and trajectory after impact.  
4. Air resistance acts on ball post-contact, modifying its path based on speed and orientation.
